_comment: Controlled parameter vocabulary per docs/03. Units are canonical SI storage units. valid_range is the QARTOD gross-range fail span (docs/04 s1, ADR-004) -- the one source of truth for the hard bounds, so the qc block below never repeats it. A parameter with no qc block gets gross range only; the other tests do not run for it. Thresholds here are provisional, tuned against the single reviewed TidbiT deployment, and are meant to be revisited as the record grows.
